about: The Three Plagues combat numbers, one source for the simulator (scripts/combat-config.ts) and the app (make fill-campaign). See RULES_AND_CLASSES.md: class bases are backfilled so the starting kit gives the step 2 totals (2026-10-04); abilities are the step 4 kit (2026-10-04); Mind is the heroes' Will against magic and fear (2026-10-05); monsters are the third calibration (2026-10-04); the Stranger is a prisoner with 1 Body and no combat stats (2026-10-05); the loot list is the approved Quest 1 finds and potions (2026-10-05), for the app's loot picker and the simulator.

abilities.name: Unburdened Charge
abilities.text: Charges 2-6 spaces (the player chooses) in one straight line; a diagonal step costs 2 spaces. The charge stops at the first enemy or wall. An enemy hit takes weapon damage + spaces charged. Traps on the path trigger, but the Barbarian takes no damage or penalty from them.

abilities.name: Unleash Fury
abilities.text: An echoing roar to the god of battle, then blind rage. The Barbarian attacks the nearest enemy, rolling the hit dice twice and keeping the better roll; allies within 2 squares get +2 Accuracy on their next attack. The rage lasts 3 rounds, or until the Barbarian kills an enemy: +3 damage on every hit and +2 mitigation, but each turn he must move to and attack an enemy if at all possible.

abilities.name: Challenge
abilities.text: Free (no action). Monsters around the Barbarian must attack him on their next turn.

abilities.name: Tough as Nails
abilities.text: +1 mitigation (already in the class's mitigation); it can bring a hit to 0.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.text: Once a turn: when the Barbarian kills a monster, he may attack another monster around him at once.

abilities.name: Multi-Shot
abilities.text: Shoots up to 3 different enemies in line of sight as one action.

abilities.name: Aimed Shot
abilities.text: A sure hit (only the crit die is rolled). The target is marked: every hero has +2 Accuracy against it until it dies or the fight ends. Movement is halved this round and next.

abilities.name: Rain of Arrows
abilities.text: Every enemy within 2 squares of a chosen square is attacked once, with half the Accuracy bonus (rounded down). Roll 1d4 arrows once; each enemy hit takes weapon damage x arrows.

abilities.name: Nimble Fingers
abilities.text: Disarms a trap on 1d8; fails only on a 1.

abilities.name: Exploit Opening
abilities.text: Crit range 13-20 (instead of 15-20) against a monster the Rogue is behind (a monster faces the hero it last attacked).

abilities.name: Fan of Cards
abilities.text: Razor-edged cards hurled at every enemy around the Rogue: one attack against each, rolled separately.

abilities.name: Venom Vial
abilities.text: Cracks a vial over the blades and strikes: a normal attack, and on a hit the target also loses 3 Body at the start of each of its next 3 turns (6 on a crit), no roll. A new vial restarts the count; it doesn't stack.

abilities.name: Vanish From Sight
abilities.text: When attacked, vanishes: the triggering attack is canceled, and no enemy can target the Rogue until the enemies' next turn cycle.

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.text: When a monster's attack on the Rogue misses, the Rogue strikes back at once for half weapon damage (rounded down), no roll.

abilities.name: Smite
abilities.text: The Cleric's main attack, at range (line of sight): rolls 1d20 + Mind to hit (faith, not the weapon's hit dice or Accuracy; Determination counts) and deals 5 damage, +2 against undead.

abilities.name: Heal Minor Wounds
abilities.text: Heals the target 12 Body, up to their maximum.

abilities.name: Turn Evil
abilities.text: The target enemy skips its next attack and cannot defend for 1 round: every hero's attack on it is a sure hit.

abilities.name: Divining
abilities.text: Reveals traps, hidden doors and treasure within 6 squares, through walls and doors.

abilities.name: Prayer
abilities.text: Free (no mana). Restores half of maximum mana, rounded up. Takes the Cleric's action; they cannot defend until their next turn. The only way to regain mana out of a fight.
